title: AI Daily 2026-11-14 · Handing It Over
description: ChatGPT Wallet asks for approval at checkout, OpenAI folds robotics into its main teams, and a logician uses AI to decipher Gödel’s notebooks.

openai-chatgpt-wallet-dots-checkout.topic: ChatGPT Wallet lets an agent shop and check out, with approval for every payment
openai-chatgpt-wallet-dots-checkout.verification_scope: Both media reports were reviewed in full for the Chinese edition. The OpenAI announcement and help pages returned HTTP 403. The Commerce Partner Playbook was not reviewed and the product was not tested.

openai-disbands-standalone-robotics-team.topic: OpenAI dissolves its standalone robotics team and moves researchers into its main research group
openai-disbands-standalone-robotics-team.verification_scope: Fortune was reviewed through Russ Tedrake’s comments, about three quarters of the story. OpenAI’s position comes from its spokesperson. The original source of the reported quarterly loss was not opened.

depue-report-chinese-models-blackwell-fi.topic: Report finds numerical traces consistent with NVIDIA Blackwell chips in six Chinese open-weight models
depue-report-chinese-models-blackwell-fi.date_note: November 12 report with November 13 coverage by TechCrunch
depue-report-chinese-models-blackwell-fi.verification_scope: The report’s executive summary, Table 1 and opening findings paragraph and two full TechCrunch stories were reviewed. The detailed method, appendices and limitations were not reviewed paragraph by paragraph. No independent replication was found or performed. Bloomberg, Epoch AI, the Culper report and lawmakers’ letter were not opened.

godel-workbooks-claude-digest-von-plato.topic: Logician uses Claude to decipher Gödel's 1,009 pages of shorthand and reports hundreds of previously unknown theorems
godel-workbooks-claude-digest-von-plato.verification_scope: The Guardian was reviewed in full. Figures and interpretations come from von Plato. No formal publication was identified. The Claude output and Coq results were not available for inspection.

langchain-series-c-3b-valuation.topic: LangChain raises $300 million at a $3 billion valuation
langchain-series-c-3b-valuation.date_note: November 13 company announcement and TechCrunch coverage
langchain-series-c-3b-valuation.verification_scope: The funding announcement at the start of the company post and the complete TechCrunch brief were reviewed. Customer numbers come from LangChain.

microsoft-365-outage-not-ai-related.topic: Microsoft 365 largely recovers after about 24 hours. Company rules out cyberattacks and AI agents
microsoft-365-outage-not-ai-related.verification_scope: WIRED was reviewed through the email queuing explanation. The company’s status page and incident review were not opened. The account of the cause comes from a spokesperson and the full review had yet to appear.

elevenlabs-elevenai-preview.topic: ElevenLabs previews ElevenAI for meeting notes, dictation and agent tasks
elevenlabs-elevenai-preview.verification_scope: Most of the TechCrunch report was reviewed. The official release was not opened and the app was not tested.

google-research-antigravity-teamwork.topic: Google Research describes Antigravity's /teamwork workflow for multiple agents
google-research-antigravity-teamwork.verification_scope: The opening and section on scaling long-horizon reasoning were reviewed. The reported results come from Google and were not individually checked.

llama-cpp-v1-0-0.topic: llama.cpp reaches v1.0.0 and reserves breaking API and ABI changes for major versions
llama-cpp-v1-0-0.verification_scope: The full release post, including versioning, distribution, development, backends and model coverage, was reviewed. The GitHub release and license were not checked and the software was not run.

cloudflare-kitesurf-open-source.topic: Cloudflare releases its Kitesurf browser for AI agents under Apache 2.0
cloudflare-kitesurf-open-source.verification_scope: Most of the Cloudflare post was reviewed, including features, repository structure, running locally and deployment. The GitHub repository and LICENSE were not checked. Performance descriptions come from Cloudflare. The browser was not run.
cloudflare-kitesurf-open-source.license: Apache-2.0 according to Cloudflare. The LICENSE file was not reviewed.

paper-justrua-gpt-6-robot-use-agents.topic: JustRUA tests which design choices help GPT-6 Astra control a robot arm
paper-justrua-gpt-6-robot-use-agents.date_note: Submitted November 11. Announced November 13 on arXiv (v1 preprint).
paper-justrua-gpt-6-robot-use-agents.verification_scope: The Chinese edition examined arXiv v1 HTML: abstract, Figure 1 caption, opening introduction, section 2.1, opening of 2.4, section 4.1, opening of 5.2, Table 9 and Takeaway 3, error analysis and opening of Table 10, conclusion and limitations. Sections 2.2–2.3, 2.5, 3.1–3.4, 4.2–4.3, 5.1 and 5.3–5.4 and the appendix were not reviewed paragraph by paragraph. Only v1 was available, without peer review.

discourse-jason-ma-deployment-is-the-ben.topic: Jason Ma on why each increase in the size of a robot deployment reveals different problems
discourse-jason-ma-deployment-is-the-ben.date_note: October 19 original episode, added October 21. Historical selection.
discourse-jason-ma-deployment-is-the-ben.verification_scope: The Concourse guide, speaker information and four excerpts were reviewed. The excerpt at 00:54:03 is marked as checked against the recording. The others were automatically extracted. The full program was not reviewed. The article paraphrases the remarks.

discourse-terence-tao-proof-abundance.topic: Terence Tao on why a growing supply of machine proofs has yet to yield a matching gain in understanding
discourse-terence-tao-proof-abundance.date_note: October 15 original episode, added October 21. Historical selection.
discourse-terence-tao-proof-abundance.verification_scope: The Concourse guide and four excerpts from automatic captions were reviewed at 00:01:54, 00:02:32, 00:15:20 and 00:16:39. The full program was not reviewed. The article paraphrases the remarks.
